items.description: https://manuzhang.github.io/awesome-streaming/ is a more dynamic website where you can find updates of the awesome projects here.

children.title: HStreamDB
children.description: [Haskell] - The streaming database built for IoT data storage and real-time processing.

children.title: RisingWave
children.description: [Rust] - A PostgreSQL-compatible streaming database that is designed to build event-driven applications, real-time ETL pipelines, continuous analytics services, and feature stores for AI applications. It excels in extracting fresh and consistent insights from real-time event streams, database CDC, and time series data within sub-seconds. It unifies streaming and batch processing, enabling users to ingest, join, and analyze both live and historical data at a cloud scale.

children.title: SPQR
children.description: [Java] - dynamic framework for processing high volumn data streams through pipelines.

children.title: Wallaroo
children.description: [Python] - A fast, stream-processing framework. Wallaroo makes it easy to react to data in real-time. By eliminating infrastructure complexity, going from prototype to production has never been simpler.

children.title: SABER
children.description: [Java/C] - Window-Based Hybrid CPU/GPU Stream Processing Engine.

children.title: Onyx
children.description: [Clojure] - Distributed, masterless, high performance, fault tolerant data processing.

children.title: ArkFlow
children.description: [Rust] - High-performance Rust stream processing engine, providing powerful data stream processing capabilities, supporting multiple input/output sources and processors.

children.title: Trill
children.description: [.NET/C#] - Trill is a high-performance one-pass in-memory streaming analytics engine from Microsoft Research.

children.title: Arroyo
children.description: [Rust] - a distributed stream processing engine. Supports SQL and Rust pipelines. Scales up to millions of events per second. Supports stateful operations like windows and joins, state checkpointing for fault-tolerance and recovery of pipelines. Uses the Timely Dataflow model.

children.title: tigon
children.description: [C++/Java] - high throughput real-time streaming processing framework built on Hadoop and HBase.

children.title: Hazelcast Jet
children.description: [Java] - A general purpose distributed data processing engine, built on top of Hazelcast.

children.title: s4
children.description: [Java] - general-purpose, distributed, scalable, fault-tolerant, pluggable platform that allows programmers to easily develop applications for processing continuous unbounded streams of data.

children.title: Apache Flink
children.description: [Java] - system for high-throughput, low-latency data stream processing that supports stateful computation, data-driven windowing semantics and iterative stream processing.

children.title: CocoIndex
children.description: [Rust/Python] - ETL framework to build fresh index for AI, with realtime incremental updates.

children.title: Apache Heron (incubating)
children.description: [Java] - a realtime, distributed, fault-tolerant stream processing engine from Twitter.

children.title: LightSaber
children.description: [C++] - Multi-core Window-Based Stream Processing Engine. LightSaber uses code generation for efficient window aggregation.

children.title: AthenaX
children.description: [Java] - Uber's Stream Analytics Framework used in production

children.title: Teknek
children.description: [Java] - Simple elegant stream processing with interactive prototying shell SOL (Stream Operator Language) Mesos, designed for high performance data processing jobs that require flexibility & control.

children.title: Kuiper
children.description: [Golang] - An edge lightweight IoT data analytics/streaming software implemented by Golang, and it can be run at all kinds of resource-constrained edge devices.

children.title: Apache Spark Streaming
children.description: [Scala] - makes it easy to build scalable fault-tolerant streaming applications.

children.title: Pathway
children.description: [Python] - The fastest data processing engine supporting unified workflows for batch, streaming data, and LLM applications.

children.title: Gearpump
children.description: [Scala] - lightweight real-time distributed streaming engine built on Akka.

children.title: Faust
children.description: [Python] - stream processing library, porting the ideas from Kafka Streams to Python

children.title: Apache Ballista
children.description: [Rust] - distributed compute platform powered by Apache Arrow.

children.title: mupd8(muppet)
children.description: [Scala/Java] - mapReduce-style framework for processing fast/streaming data.

children.title: NebulaStream
children.description: [C++] - High-performance, general-purpose, end-to-end data-management system for cloud-edge-sensor environments.

children.title: mantis
children.description: [Java] - Netflix's platform to build an ecosystem of realtime stream processing applications

children.title: Scramjet Cloud Platform
children.description: [Python/JavaScript/Node.js] - data processing engine for running multiple data processing apps (sequences) written in Python, JavaScript or TypeScript

children.title: Apache Storm
children.description: [Clojure/Java] - distributed real-time computation system. Storm is to stream processing what Hadoop is to batch processing.

children.title: Bytewax
children.description: [Python] - data parallel, distributed, stateful stream processing framework.

children.title: hailstorm
children.description: [Haskell] - distributed stream processing with exactly-once semantics based on Storm.

children.title: Apache Samza
children.description: [Scala/Java] - distributed stream processing framework that build on Kafka(messaging, storage) and YARN(fault tolerance, processor isolation, security and resource management).

children.title: Apache Apex
children.description: [Java] - unified platform for big data stream and batch processing.

children.title: Numaflow
children.description: [Java/Python/Go/Rust] - Kubernetes native stream processing platform with language agnostic framework. Scalable and cost-efficient

children.title: Maki Nage
children.description: [Python] - A stream processing framework for data scientists, based on Kafka and ReactiveX.

children.title: YoMo
children.description: [Go] - An open source Streaming Serverless Framework for building Low-latency Geo-distributed system. YoMo Built atop QUIC Transport Protocol and Functional Reactive Programming interface.

children.title: Streamline
children.description: [Java] - Stream Analytics Framework by Hortonworks, designed as a wrapper around existing streaming solutions like Storm. Aimed to allow users to drag-and-drop streaming components to focus on business logic.

children.title: FastStream
children.description: [Python] - powerful and easy-to-use Python library simplifying the process of writing producers and consumers for message queues, handling all the parsing, networking and documentation generation automatically. Supports multiple protocols such as Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ and alike.

children.title: Streamz
children.description: [Python] - A lightweight library for building pipelines to manage continuous streams of data; supports complex pipelines that involve branching, joining, flow control, feedback, back pressure, and so on.

children.title: Scramjet C++
children.description: [C++] functional reactive stream programming framework written on top of Node.js object streams.

children.title: Scramjet Python
children.description: [Python] functional reactive stream programming framework written from scratch operating on object, string and buffer streams.

children.title: Streamiz
children.description: [C#] - a .Net Stream Processing Library for Apache Kafka

children.title: Swave
children.description: [Scala] - A lightweight Reactive Streams Infrastructure Toolkit for Scala.

children.title: Tributary
children.description: [Python] - A python library for constructing dataflow graphs. Supports synchronous, reactive data streams built using python generators that mimic complex event processors, as well as lazily-evaluated acyclic graphs and functional currying streams.

children.title: Mediapipe
children.description: Cross-platform, customizable ML solutions for live and streaming media.

children.title: Stream Ops
children.description: [Java] - A fully embeddable data streaming engine and stream processing API for Java.

children.title: StreamAlert
children.description: [Python] - Airbnb's Real-time Data Analysis and Alerting.

children.title: monix
children.description: [Scala] - high-performance Scala / Scala.js library for composing asynchronous and event-based programs.

children.title: Apache Kafka Streams
children.description: [Java] - lightweight stream processing library included in Apache Kafka (since 0.10 version).

children.title: Akka Streams
children.description: [Scala] - stream processing library on Akka Actors.

children.title: Benthos
children.description: [Go] - Benthos is a high performance and resilient message streaming service, able to connect various sources and sinks and perform arbitrary actions, transformations and filters on payloads

children.title: Quix Streams
children.description: [Python] - a streaming library originally designed for the McLaren Formula 1 racing team that can process high volumes of time-series data with up to nanosecond precision using Apache Kafka as a message broker.

children.title: FS2(prev. 'Scalaz-Stream')
children.description: [Scala] - Compositional, streaming I/O library for Scala.

children.title: Scramjet Node.js
children.description: [Node.js] functional reactive stream programming framework written on top of Node.js object streams + the legacy Scramjet.js version

children.title: Substation
children.description: [Go] - Substation is a cloud native data pipeline and transformation toolkit written in Go.

children.title: Daggy
children.description: [C++] - real-time streams aggregation and catching.

children.title: Zilla
children.description: [Java] - Cross-platform, API gateway built for event-driven architectures and streaming that supports standard protocols such as HTTP, SSE, gRPC, MQTT and the native Kafka protocol.

children.title: storm-crawler
children.description: [Java] - Web crawler SDK based on Apache Storm.

children.title: straw
children.description: [Python/Java] - A platform for real-time streaming search.

children.title: javactrl-kafka
children.description: [Java] - An application of a stateful stream processing for workflow as Java code (microservices orchestration, business process automation, and more).

children.title: sensorbee
children.description: [Go] - lightweight stream processing engine for IoT.

children.title: Apache Edgent
children.description: [Java] - a programming model and runtime that enables continuous streaming analytics on gateways and edge devices which can work with centralized systems to provide efficient and timely analytics across the whole IoT ecosystem: from the center to the edge, opens sourced by IBM.

children.title: Apache StreamPipes
children.description: [Java] - a self-service (Industrial) IoT toolbox to enable non-technical users to connect, analyze and explore IoT data streams.

children.title: summingbird
children.description: [Scala] - library that lets you write MapReduce programs that look like native Scala or Java collection transformations and execute them on a number of well-known distributed MapReduce platforms, including Storm and Scalding.

children.title: Esper
children.description: [Java] - component for complex event processing (CEP) and event series analysis.

children.title: Streamparse
children.description: [Python] - lets you run Python code against real-time streams of data via Apache Storm.

children.title: coast
children.description: [Scala] - a DSL that builds DAGs on top of Samza and provides exactly-once semantics.

children.title: Apache Beam
children.description: [Java, Python, SQL, Scala, Go] - unified model and set of language-specific SDKs for defining and executing data processing workflows, and also data ingestion and integration flows, supporting Enterprise Integration Patterns (EIPs) and Domain Specific Languages (DSLs), open sourced by Google.

children.title: databus
children.description: [Java] - Linkedin's source-agnostic distributed change data capture system.

children.title: brooklin
children.description: [Java] - a distributed system intended for streaming data between various heterogeneous source and destination systems with high reliability and throughput at scale from Linkedin (replaced databus).

children.title: Redpanda
children.description: [C++] - Redpanda is Kafka compatible, ZooKeeper-free, JVM-free and source available.

children.title: Bruin
children.description: [Go] - End-to-end data pipeline tool combining ingestion from 50+ sources, SQL/Python transformations, and built-in data quality checks in a single CLI.

children.title: AutoMQ
children.description: [Scala/Java] - cloud-first alternative to Kafka by decoupling durability to S3 and EBS. 100% Kafka compatible. 10x cost-effective. Autoscale in seconds. Single-digit ms latency.

children.title: NATS streaming
children.description: [Go] - fast disk-backed messaging solution

children.title: Apache RocketMQ
children.description: [Java] - distributed messaging and streaming platform with low latency, high performance and reliability, trillion-level capacity and flexible scalability.

children.title: ingestr
children.description: [Python] - CLI tool to copy data between any source and destination with a single command. Supports 50+ connectors including databases, SaaS apps, and data warehouses.

children.title: metaq
children.description: [Java] - Taobao's high available, high performance distributed messaging system

children.title: nsq
children.description: [Go] - realtime distributed messaging platform designed to operate at scale, handling billions of messages per day.

children.title: Apache Kafka
children.description: [Scala/Java] - distributed, partitioned, replicated commit log service, which provides the functionality of a messaging system, but with a unique design.

children.title: suro
children.description: [Java] - data pipeline service for collecting, aggregating, and dispatching large volume of application events including log data.

children.title: camus
children.description: [Java] - Linkedin's Kafka -> HDFS pipeline.

children.title: RudderStack
children.description: [Go] - an open source customer data infrastructure (segment, mparticle alternative).

children.title: fluvio
children.description: [Rust/WASM] - Real-time programmable data streaming platform with in-line computation capabilities.

children.title: flume
children.description: [Java] - distributed, reliable, and available service for efficiently collecting, aggregating, and moving large amounts of log data.

children.title: Gazette
children.description: [golang] - Distributed streaming infrastructure built on cloud storage which makes it easy to mix and match batch and streaming paradigms.

children.title: Apache Pulsar
children.description: [Java] - distributed pub-sub messaging platform with a very flexible messaging model and an intuitive client API.

children.title: Apache Samoa
children.description: [Java] - distributed streaming machine learning (ML) framework that contains a programing abstraction for distributed streaming ML algorithms.

children.title: River
children.description: [Python] - online machine learning library.

children.title: yurita
children.description: [Scala] - Anomaly detection framework built on Spark Structured Streaming from Paypal.

children.title: StreamingBandit
children.description: [Python] - Provides a webserver to quickly setup and evaluate possible solutions to contextual multi-armed bandit (cMAB) problems.

children.title: StormCV
children.description: [Java] - enables the use of Apache Storm for video processing by adding computer vision (CV) specific operations and data model.

children.title: trident-ml
children.description: [Java] - realtime online machine learning library based on Trident.

children.title: [Numalogic] (https://github.com/numaproj/numalogic
children.description: ) [Python] - Collection of ML models and libraries for real-time anomaly detection and forecasting on time series data. Built on Numaflow, a K8s native stream processing platform

children.title: DataSketches
children.description: [Java] - sketches library from Yahoo!.

children.title: streamDM
children.description: [Scala] - mining Big Data streams using Spark Streaming from Huawei.

children.title: Proton
children.description: [C++] - A unified streaming and historical data analytics database in a single binary, powered by ClickHouse.

children.title: ksqlDB
children.description: [Java] - A cloud-native, source-available database purpose-built for stream processing applications

children.title: pipelinedb
children.description: [C] - An open-source relational database that runs SQL queries continuously on streams, incrementally storing results in tables.

children.title: StreamCQL
children.description: [Java] - Continuous Query Language on RealTime Computation System.

children.title: Siddhi
children.description: [Java] - A cloud native Streaming and Complex Event Processing engine that understands Streaming SQL queries in order to capture events from diverse data sources, process them, detect complex conditions, and publish output to various endpoints in real time.

children.title: squall
children.description: [Java] - Squall executes SQL queries on top of Storm for doing online processing.

children.title: flotilla
children.description: [Go] - Automated message queue orchestration for scaled-up benchmarking.

children.title: storm-perf-test
children.description: [Java] - a simple storm performance/stress test.

children.title: streaming-benchmarks
children.description: [Java] - Benchmarks for Low Latency (Streaming) solutions including Apache Storm, Apache Spark, Apache Flink, etc.

children.title: StreamFlow
children.description: [Java] - stream processing tool designed to help build and monitor processing workflows.

children.title: Nussknacker
children.description: [Scala] - A visual tool to define and run real-time decision algorithms.

children.title: pulsar
children.description: [Python] - Actor based event driven concurrent framework for Python.

children.title: akka
children.description: [Scala] - toolkit and runtime for building highly concurrent, distributed, and resilient message-driven application on the JVM.

children.title: samza-luwak
children.description: [Java] - uses Luwak, a stored-query engine built on Lucene, to implement full-text search on streams.

children.title: Turbine
children.description: [Java] - tool for aggregating streams of Server-Sent Event (SSE) JSON data into a single stream.

children.title: Apache Pekko
children.description: [Scala, Java] - Fork of Akka 2.6.x, prior to the Akka project's adoption of the Business Source License.

children.title: aeron
children.description: [Java/C++] - efficient reliable unicast and multicast message transport.
